analyst_note:
2026-10-14: Best Friends and An Unexpected Adventure (wordless) reviewed for this claim. Best Friends repeats a refusal line on 3 spreads, then reverses it by action rather than changing the line. The wordless book is not counted.

African Storybook: Bohlale supports (near-quit line x3), Chicken and Millipede repeats a comparison structure. StoryWeaver: Good Night, Monu supports (refrain at pp 2, 5, 13 answers the child's good nights; comfort function, fits m003). 2026-10-20: The Red Umbrella is wordless and not counted.
2026-10-28: +6 support, +2 counter. Both new non-Book Dash books support: The Lost Ball (Room to Read) repeats a shoutable answer on three spreads; Get Down, Rocky! (Pratham) gives each helper the same 'idea' line on three spreads. Book Dash: Who Ate My Hat, Dudu's Hat, Clever Pig (2-3 word lines, missed by the CLI's 4-word counter) and A House for Mouse support; A Day Out (no line returns) and Let's Go Looking (a frame on 2 spreads, not a line) count against. All repeated lines this week are positive or neutral (m003). Sources of the new works: Book Dash — A Day Out, Who Ate My Hat, Let's Go Looking, Dudu's Hat, Clever Pig, A House for Mouse, Goldfish Genius; StoryWeaver — Get Down, Rocky! (Pratham Books), The Lost Ball (Room to Read, translated from Bangla).
2026-10-28 older-book observation, NOT counted (SOURCES.md keeps populations apart): Millions of Cats (Internet Archive, 1928, Gág, study_only) supports (a five-step cat count returns on five pages, passed between speakers).
2026-11-13: +5 support, +5 counter. Sweet Dreams repeats each sweet's name twice inside its own verse but no line returns across spreads: counted as structure only. Sources of the new works: Book Dash — A Trip to the Tap (2023), Going Places (2025), AAAAAHHH!!!! Mmawe! (2024), Can We Eat a Rainbow? (2026), I Can Do It! magicpaper.suggested: Distinguish deliberate refrains (a line the listener can join, changed once at the end) from accidental repetition before treating all repetition as a defect.
